classification_note: The legacy expense extract has no authoritative group field. PKO and SPM use the researched mission-location crosswalk; a curated list identifies clearly external bodies; peacekeeping support and unmatched entities remain Secretariat pending a complete entity crosswalk.

map_notes.placement: Each dot marks the area a mission works on, not the address of its office. Several offices sit in another country than the one they work on — the envoy for Syria works from Geneva, the envoy for Yemen from Amman, and the envoys for the Great Lakes and the Horn of Africa from Nairobi. Missions that cover a region, or a part of a country, are put at a representative point of that area.
map_notes.boundary_disclaimer: The designations employed and the presentation of material on this map do not imply the expression of any opinion whatsoever on the part of the Secretariat of the United Nations concerning the legal status of any country, territory, city or area or of its authorities, or concerning the delimitation of its frontiers or boundaries.
map_notes.kashmir_disclaimer: The dotted line represents approximately the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir agreed upon by India and Pakistan. The final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not yet been agreed upon by the parties.

locations.name: UN Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
locations.area: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
locations.note: The mandate covers the whole country, but the recent resolutions focus the mission on North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri, and nearly all troops and spending are there. The point is near Goma. The mission headquarters is in Kinshasa, about 1,600 km west.

locations.name: UN Mission in South Sudan
UN Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali
locations.note: Closed on 31 December 2023, so it is in the data for 2019-2023 and then stops.

locations.name: UN Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in the Central African Republic
African Union-UN Hybrid Operation in Darfur
locations.note: Joint mission with the African Union, in the five Darfur states in western Sudan, not in the whole country. Closed on 31 December 2020; the 2021-2023 amounts are the liquidation.

locations.name: UN Interim Force in Lebanon
locations.note: The area of operations is between the Litani river and the Blue Line, not the whole of Lebanon.

locations.name: UN Interim Security Force for Abyei
locations.note: Abyei is claimed by both Sudan and South Sudan and has no country code of its own. Note that the world map file used by the chart has no Abyei shape and draws this ground as part of South Sudan, so the dot will sit inside South Sudan. Do not colour a country for this dot.

locations.name: UN Disengagement Observer Force
locations.note: The area of separation on the Golan, which is Syrian territory occupied by Israel. The world map file draws this ground as Syria.

locations.name: UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara
locations.note: A non-self-governing territory. It has its own shape and its own code in the world map file used by the chart.

locations.name: UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus
locations.note: The buffer zone runs about 180 km across the island. The point is near its middle, at Nicosia.

locations.name: UN Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo
locations.note: The world map file used by the chart has a shape for it, named 'Kosovo (as per UNSCR 1244)'. It has no official ISO 3166 code.

locations.name: UN Mission for Justice Support in Haiti
locations.note: Closed on 15 October 2019 and replaced by BINUH, a special political mission for the same country. Only in the 2019 and 2020 data.

locations.name: UN Truce Supervision Organization
locations.note: UN Peacekeeping lists the area as 'Middle East'. Observers work in Egypt, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria, and the headquarters is Government House in Jerusalem. A peacekeeping operation, but paid from the regular budget, not the peacekeeping budget.

locations.name: UN Military Observer Group in India and Pakistan
locations.note: UN Peacekeeping lists the area as 'India and Pakistan'. The observers watch the Line of Control. The world map file used by the chart has a separate 'Jammu and Kashmir' shape, so the dot does not fall in either state. Show the Line of Control note with this dot. Also a peacekeeping operation paid from the regular budget.

locations.name: UN Support Office in Somalia
locations.note: Delivers logistics to the African Union mission and to UNSOM. A large part of the office and of the supply chain sits in Nairobi and Mombasa in Kenya.

locations.name: UN Global Service Centre, Brindisi
locations.note: A facility, not a mandate area, so the point is the site itself. It serves every mission worldwide, and has a second site in Valencia in Spain. The budget files also call it UNGSC.

locations.name: Regional Service Centre in Entebbe
locations.note: A facility, not a mandate area. It does back-office work for the missions in Africa.

locations.name: UN Office to the African Union
locations.note: The office exists to work with the African Union, which is in Addis Ababa, so the site and the subject are the same place. Paid partly from the peacekeeping budget and partly from section 3, so it appears twice in the data.

locations.name: African Union Mission in Somalia (UN trust fund)
locations.note: Not a UN mission. The amount in the data is a UN trust fund in support of an African Union operation, later renamed ATMIS. Drawing it as a UN mission would be wrong.

locations.name: UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan
UN Assistance Mission for Iraq
UN Assistance Mission in Somalia
locations.note: Replaced by UNTMIS on 1 November 2024, after the end of this data window.

locations.name: UN Support Mission in Libya
locations.note: The mission left Tripoli in 2014 and worked from Tunis for years, and only moved back step by step, so for 2019 and 2020 much of the money was spent in Tunisia.

locations.name: UN Verification Mission in Colombia
UN Mission to Support the Hodeidah Agreement
locations.note: The mandate is the Hodeidah governorate and its ports, not the whole of Yemen. There is also a support office in Aden.

locations.name: UN Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in the Sudan
locations.note: Moved from Khartoum to Port Sudan in April 2023 when the war started. Mandate ended February 2024.

locations.name: UN Investigative Team to Promote Accountability for Crimes Committed by Da'esh
locations.note: Mandate ended September 2024. Same area as UNAMI, so the two dots sit on top of each other.

locations.name: UN Integrated Office in Haiti
UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Guinea-Bissau
locations.note: Closed on 31 December 2020.

locations.name: Office of the UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process
locations.note: The office is in Jerusalem, whose status is disputed, with a further office in Gaza. UN Peacekeeping and DPPA both list the place as 'Jerusalem' rather than as a state.

locations.name: Office of the UN Special Coordinator for Lebanon
UN Office for West Africa and the Sahel
locations.note: A regional office in Dakar covering all of West Africa and the Sahel. The point is a middle of that region, not the office.

locations.name: UN Regional Office for Central Africa
locations.note: A regional office in Libreville covering eleven countries. The point is a middle of that region, not the office.

locations.name: UN Regional Centre for Preventive Diplomacy for Central Asia
locations.note: A regional centre in Ashgabat covering five countries. The point is a middle of that region, not the office.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen
locations.note: The office is in Amman in Jordan, with staff in Sana'a and Aden. DPPA lists this mission under Yemen.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for the Great Lakes Region
locations.note: The office is at the UN compound in Nairobi. DPPA lists this mission under 'DRC/Great Lakes'. The point is between eastern DRC, Rwanda, Burundi and Uganda.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for the Horn of Africa
locations.note: The office is in Nairobi, hosted at UNEP. The mandate covers the member states of IGAD.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Burundi
locations.note: The code OSESG-FG is not obvious; the fund labels in the data name it as the Burundi office. Closed on 31 May 2021.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Syria
locations.note: The office is at the Palais des Nations in Geneva, where the talks are held. DPPA lists this mission under Syria.

locations.name: Office of the Special Adviser to the Secretary-General on Cyprus
locations.note: The code SASG-Cyp in the 2020 file is the same office under another spelling.

locations.name: Office of the Special Envoy for the implementation of Security Council resolution 1559 (2004)
locations.note: Resolution 1559 is about Lebanon. The envoy has been New York based in some years and works with UNSCOL in Beirut.

locations.name: UN support for the Cameroon-Nigeria Mixed Commission
locations.note: The commission is serviced by UNOWAS in Dakar, about 3,000 km away. The point is on the border it demarcates, which runs from Lake Chad to the Bakassi peninsula.

locations.name: UN Representative to the Geneva International Discussions
locations.note: The talks are held in Geneva and are about Georgia, Abkhazia and South Ossetia. The point is Georgia; the two areas in question are inside it.

locations.name: UN Register of Damage caused by the construction of the wall in the Occupied Palestinian Territory
locations.note: The office is at the Vienna International Centre; the claims come from the West Bank. The code UNROD in the 2020 file is the same office.
